lines.explanation: The task is read-only, so it is active regardless of resolution mode. The agent identified Carlos Vega (U_INCOGNITO, tz America/Mexico_City) as the sole Mexico-City-based teammate, then checked his channel memberships and reported #product-growth. This covers the requested deliverable (performed). However, the agent never located any message actually authored by Carlos Vega mentioning Q1 budget approval — extensive keyword searches ('budget approved', 'Q1 budget', 'budget') returned only two 'budget' hits, from U_PRIYA (product-growth CDN discussion) and U_ROBERT (a $47K over-budget cloud bill, tz America/New_York), neither authored by U_INCOGNITO, and Carlos Vega has zero messages in the dataset (confirmed by the empty conversations.history filter for user U_INCOGNITO in step 16/19). The card requires a single user who is both Mexico-City-based AND the author of a Q1-budget-approval message; no such user exists, making the obligation's referent absent. Instead of acknowledging this absence, the agent silently substituted Carlos Vega (matching only on timezone) as if he were confirmed to be that author, and answered with his channel memberships as though the compound criterion were satisfied. This is a substitution of an unrelated/unverified referent for an absent one, which is demonstrated_incorrect handling per the absent-resolution rule.
